sd-add-southern-california-tribal-fdpir-.title: Southern California Tribal FDPIR Food Distribution
sd-add-southern-california-tribal-fdpir-.status: USDA FDPIR; monthly distribution rotates to each reservation (Pala, Rincon, Pauma, La Jolla, San Pasqual, Mesa Grande, Los Coyotes, Campo, Viejas, Barona, Santa Ysabel). Call for the current calendar. Phone: (760) 749-5608.
sd-add-southern-california-tribal-fdpir-.eligibility: Tribal/Native American low-income households near reservations; cannot also receive CalFresh; SSN required

items.title: St. Vincent de Paul Pantry at Our Lady of Mount Carmel — Free Food
items.description: Free food at St. Vincent de Paul Pantry at Our Lady of Mount Carmel (SVdP / Our Lady of Mount Carmel Parish). Schedule: Mon 2 PM–7 PM; Fri 2 PM–6 PM (diapers Fri 3-6pm). Eligibility: Local residents in need. Call (619) 428-1415 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Sep 2026.
